string-array.name: reasons_smoking
string-array.item: I choose a life free from cigarettes
My risk of cancer, heart disease and stroke will drop
I will breathe easier and have more energy
I want to smell fresh and look healthier
I will save a lot of money

string-array.name: reasons_alcohol
string-array.item: I want to wake up clear-headed every day
My liver, heart and sleep will thank me
I want to be present for the people I love
I will stop regretting what I said or did
I will save money and time

string-array.name: reasons_porn
string-array.item: I want real intimacy and connection
I want my focus and motivation back
I want to feel in control of my desires
I want more time for things that matter

string-array.name: reasons_sugar
string-array.item: I want stable energy through the day
I want to lose weight and feel lighter
I want healthier teeth and skin
I want to lower my risk of diabetes

string-array.name: reasons_gambling

string-array.name: reasons_procrastination
string-array.item: I want to finish what I start

I want to feel proud of my time

string-array.name: reasons_social
string-array.item: I want my attention back
I want to stop comparing myself to others

I want more time for real people

string-array.item: I want to be in control of my life

resources.string: Quit a habit, one day at a time. Watch the days, money and time you win back.
Free. No ads, no premium, no catch
No account. Your data stays on this phone
Trophies, savings, diary and SOS help
What do you want to quit?
Pick the habit you want to leave behind. You can add more later.
Why do you want to quit?
Your reasons will hold you up in the hard moments.
A rough guess is fine. It shows how many times you have avoided it.
How much did it cost you?
Small amounts turn into big numbers over time.
Currency can be changed in settings.
How much time did it take?
Minutes you barely noticed add up to days.
This is your starting point. The counter begins here.
Nothing tracked yet. Add a habit you want to leave behind.
Notes, cravings you beat and slips will show up here.
It will be removed from the diary.
The counter goes back as if it never happened, and your %s streak continues.
A craving peaks and fades within minutes. Breathe with the circle until it passes.
You have already held on for %s.
Well done. Logged in your diary.
A slip is not the end. The %s you held on still count, and your best streak stays.
Tell how much money and time the habit used to take, and you\'ll see what you win back.
Add something you\'d love to buy. The money you don\'t spend on the habit pays for it.
%s will be taken from your savings. You earned it.
It will be removed from the list.
The money spent on it will return to your savings.
Add the money it cost you to plan rewards.
Why are you doing this? Write it down for the hard moments.
General guidance, not medical advice. Every body is different.
Heart rate and blood pressure begin to drop
Carbon monoxide in the blood falls by half, oxygen levels recover
Carbon monoxide is cleared from the body
Taste and smell start to come back
Nicotine is out of the body; breathing gets easier
Coughing and shortness of breath decrease
Risk of heart disease is about half that of a smoker
Stroke risk falls close to a non-smoker\'s
Lung cancer risk is about half that of a smoker
Blood sugar stabilises, the body clears the alcohol
Withdrawal eases, sleep starts to recover
Sleep is deeper, skin looks better hydrated
Stomach lining heals, fewer calories, weight drops
Liver fat begins to decrease, blood pressure improves
Energy, mood and focus are clearly better
Risk of liver disease and several cancers goes down
Blood sugar spikes and crashes calm down
Cravings peak, then begin to fade
Energy is more stable through the day
Skin clearer, less bloating, weight may drop
Lower risk factors for diabetes and heart disease
You have proved you can go a day
The first, hardest wave of cravings is behind you
New routines are starting to form
The brain\'s reward system starts to rebalance
The new way feels normal; urges are rarer and weaker
A whole year: this is who you are now
Each bar is one streak. The green one is the current.
You have done this before. You can do it again.
All its history, diary, reasons and rewards will be deleted. This can\'t be undone.
So we can celebrate each new trophy with you.
A note when you reach a new milestone
Some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung) stop background apps. Allow autostart and turn off battery restrictions for Unhook.
Everything is stored only on this phone. Save a backup file to move to a new phone or keep it safe.
Current habits and history will be replaced with the ones from the file.
Something went wrong. Is it an Unhook backup file?
Unhook is free and open source. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking, no account. Made with care for anyone breaking a habit.

string-array.name: quotes
string-array.item: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.|Lao Tzu
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.|Will Durant
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.|Confucius
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.|Mark Twain
Fall seven times, stand up eight.|Japanese proverb
You don\'t have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.|Martin Luther King Jr.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.|Abraham Lincoln (attributed)
Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.|Jim Ryun
The chains of habit are too weak to be felt until they are too strong to be broken.|Samuel Johnson
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.|James Clear
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.|Confucius
Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.|Robert Collier
What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.|Ralph Marston
Strength does not come from winning. Your struggles develop your strengths.|Arnold Schwarzenegger
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.|Chinese proverb
A river cuts through rock not because of its power, but because of its persistence.|Jim Watkins
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.|Confucius
The only way out is through.|Robert Frost
Be stronger than your strongest excuse.|Unknown
You are not your cravings. They come and they go.|Unknown
First we make our habits, then our habits make us.|Charles C. Noble
One day or day one. You decide.|Unknown
Freedom is what you do with what\'s been done to you.|Jean-Paul Sartre
Courage doesn\'t always roar. Sometimes it\'s the quiet voice saying: I will try again tomorrow.|Mary Anne Radmacher
Little by little, one travels far.|J. R. R. Tolkien
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.|Confucius
Don\'t count the days, make the days count.|Muhammad Ali
No one is free who is not master of himself.|Epictetus
Change is hard at first, messy in the middle and gorgeous at the end.|Robin Sharma
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.|Marcus Aurelius
